business_summary: Langu Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides valuation and advisory services in Hong Kong. It operates through Valuation and Advisory Services; Financing Services; and Securities Broking, Placing and Underwriting, and Investment Advisory and Asset Management Services segments. The company offers asset appraisal and asset advisory services, including real estate and fixed asset appraisal, mineral property appraisal, business and intangible asset valuation, and financial instrument valuation and advisory services, as well as environmental, social, and governance (ESG) and sustainability reporting services. It also provides personal loans, commercial loans, and mortgage loans to individuals and corporations; securities broking and trading services to investors; equity and debt securities placing and underwriting services to listed companies; and investment advisory and asset management services to professional investors. In addition, the company offers property, works of art, machinery and equipment, biological assets, and purchase price allocation valuation services; corporate and risk advisory services, such as auction, property agency, land advisory, credit and risk evaluation, internal control advisory, and background search and due diligence; valuation on real estate and agency services; and natural resources valuation and technical advisory services. Further, it is involved in the provision of consultancy, marketing, event organization, and credit report services, as well as property investment activities. The company was formerly known as Roma (meta) Group Limited and changed its name to Langu Company Limited in January 2026. Langu Company Limited was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Langu Company Limited는 홍콩에서 평가 및 자문 서비스를 제공합니다. 평가 및 자문 서비스를 통해 운영됩니다. 금융 서비스; 증권 중개, 배치 및 인수, 투자 자문 및 자산 관리 서비스 부문. 이 회사는 부동산 및 고정 자산 평가, 광물 자산 평가, 비즈니스 및 무형 자산 평가, 금융 상품 평가 및 자문 서비스는 물론 환경, 사회 및 거버넌스(ESG) 및 지속 가능성 보고 서비스를 포함한 자산 평가 및 자산 자문 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 개인 및 기업에 개인 대출, 상업 대출 및 모기지 대출을 제공합니다. 투자자를 위한 증권 중개 및 거래 서비스; 상장회사에 대한 주식 및 채무증권 발행 및 인수 서비스; 전문투자자를 대상으로 투자자문 및 자산관리 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 재산, 미술품, 기계 및 장비, 생물 자산, 구매 가격 배분 평가 서비스를 제공합니다. 경매, 부동산 중개소, 토지 자문, 신용 및 리와 같은 기업 및 위험 자문 서비스
